title: Feline leukocyte immunophenotyping: an optimised whole-blood flow cytometry protocol
author: Lopes, Rodrigues-Santos, et al.
materials: Step 1 - Sample collection and preservation procedure

Reagents•Monoclonal antibodies:○CD5 Anti-cat – clone FE1.1B11 (BIO-RAD®)○CD4 Anti-cat – clone vpg34 (BIO-RAD®)○CD8 Anti-cat alpha/beta purified – clone vpg9 (BIO-RAD®)○Rat Anti-Mouse IgG1 – clone X56 (BIO-RAD®)○CD18 Mouse Anti-Dog – clone CA1.4E9 (BIO-RAD®)○CD21 Mouse Anti-Dog – clone CA2.1D6 (BIO-RAD®)○CD45R Rat Anti-Mouse – clone RA3–6B2 (BIO-RAD®)•10x Red blood cells (RBC) lysis buffer solution (BD FACS™ lysing solution)•PBS 1% solution

Equipment•Countess ™ 3 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA)•Freezer•Dark incubation chamber•Timer•Vortex (MX-S®, China)•Centrifuge (model 5810R, Eppendorf®, Germany)•Flow cytometry analyser BD FACSCanto II (Becton Dickinson (BD), San Jose, USA)

steps.title: Collect and preserve whole blood
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2 mL sterile syringe with a 23 G × 25 mm needle, restrain the cat with minimal stress, aseptically clean the jugular site, apply alcohol then chlorhexidine, draw blood using low vacuum to avoid turbulence, immediately transfer the blood into an Aquisel K3 EDTA tube (0.5 or 1.0 mL), gently shake for 1 min, and store the tube in a HulaMixer at room temperature (RT) for up to 48 h. For storage beyond 48 h add 200 µL TransFix® per 1 mL whole blood, homogenise, and keep at 18–25 °C (up to 4 days) or 2–8 °C (up to 14 days).

substeps.instruction: Prepare the 2 mL sterile syringe and 23 G × 25 mm needle.
Restrain and position the animal with minimal stress.
Aseptically clean the jugular venipuncture site.
Apply alcohol with a gauze pad, then chlorhexidine.
Perform jugular venipuncture using low vacuum pressure.
Place the whole blood into an EDTA collection tube immediately.
Gently shake the tube for 1 minute to ensure homogenisation.
Store the tube in a sample mixer at RT for up to 48 h.
If analysis will be >48 h, add 200 µL TransFix® per 1 mL blood, mix gently, and store at 18–25 °C (≤4 days) or 2–8 °C (≤14 days).

steps.title: Extracellular staining of leukocytes
steps.instruction: Using the collected whole‑blood (EDTA ± TransFix®), assess viability with trypan blue, then stain 100 µL of blood with 10 µL of each required primary antibody, incubate 15 min in a dark RT chamber, lyse red cells with 2 mL 10× BD FACS™ lysing solution, incubate 10 min in the dark, wash twice with PBS 1% (centrifuge 5 min at 1500 rpm without brake each time), resuspend in 200 µL PBS 1% and acquire on the BD FACSCanto II. If secondary antibodies are used, perform an additional PBS 1% wash, centrifuge, discard supernatant, then incubate 15 min in the dark with the secondary antibody before the final wash and acquisition.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 10 µL whole blood into a microcentrifuge tube.
Add 10 µL 0.4 % trypan blue, mix gently, load into the Countess 3 chamber and record viability.
Pipette 100 µL whole blood into a flow‑cytometry tube.
Add 10 µL of each selected primary monoclonal antibody (CD5, CD4, CD8, Rat anti‑Mouse IgG1, CD18, CD21, CD45R).
Vortex briefly and incubate 15 min in a dark chamber at RT.
Add 2 mL 10× RBC lysis buffer (BD FACS™ lysing solution), vortex, and incubate 10 min in the dark at RT.
Centrifuge 5 min at 1500 rpm without brake; discard supernatant.
Add 2 mL PBS 1%, vortex, then centrifuge 5 min at 1500 rpm without brake; discard supernatant.
If secondary antibodies are to be used: add 2 mL PBS 1%, vortex, centrifuge as above, discard supernatant, then add the secondary antibody cocktail, vortex, and incubate 15 min in the dark at RT.
After any secondary‑antibody step (or directly if none), add 2 mL PBS 1%, vortex, centrifuge 5 min at 1500 rpm without brake, discard supernatant.
Pipette 200 µL PBS 1% into the tube, vortex gently.
Acquire the sample on the BD FACSCanto II flow cytometer.
